Hello John,

I hope you are having a great week. My name is Marcos Gonzalez and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, a D.C.-based government contracting law firm. I wanted to recognize Taurus's remarkable rise. Standing up the company in 2022 and, within roughly two years, becoming FEMA's Direct Servicing Agent for NFIP Direct, servicing more than 600,000 flood policies nationwide, is no small feat. As that footprint grows, a few legal realities tend to come with it. Holding a small-business set-aside while operating alongside affiliated entities under shared ownership tends to raise affiliation and size questions that are far easier to get ahead of than to defend against a competitor's protest. And administering federal policyholder data at this scale brings Privacy Act and DHS data-handling obligations that reward steady legal attention. We help contractors keep issues like these from ever slowing operations down.

I would love to connect briefly to introduce myself and see how we might support Taurus as it continues to grow. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerks, who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Warmly,
Marcos Gonzalez
Managing Attorney
GovSpring Legal
